items.title: Reconcile shared hook/webapp versions and host permission deltas
items.problem: Existing adoption must be updated through hashes and host-specific validation rather than blindly reinstalling components.
acceptance: Compare lock pins with canonical manifests and current-source drift before proposing an update.
Run target-context negative cases and compare minimal versus optional-feature permissions.
Keep Maester execution and reporting host-specific; record exact source hashes and candidate/pilot status.
validation: Read and compare lock hashes with canonical reference source; do not overwrite drift.
evidence: Adopted pilot maester-azd-hooks 0.1.6 from immutable azd-reference revision a09cac311aac7362f56d2a31833ed90ce5812649. All eight managed targets match the component manifest and lock; only Maester-UpWizard.psm1 changed from 0.1.5, to require a non-empty GUID before persisting the optional Web App group Object ID.
Preserved maester-report-webapp 0.1.1 at immutable revision 79f0608c672639aae0f0ed96d160b1eb17cfc08f with exact vendored hash 4b12708c76489f3f20e031fdafc706a3062276ef4a83fda7f5109f4cbd902972.

Added a schema-valid partial permission manifest with exactly 24 source-proven declarations: eight Minimal runtime roles, eleven additional default Extended roles, four deployment-operator scopes, and optional Mail.Send. Working and raw-index comparisons returned 8/19/20/4 permissions with no evidence findings; comparisonComplete remains false and explicit gaps preserve unmodeled Azure RBAC, optional feature, operator and cleanup authority.

The 0.1.6 permission helper is byte-identical to 0.1.5 at SHA-256 e43b6e4ce60c9adef30355cc126519e5f754c01630c94fca9d85c04aebde3548; this adoption adds no declared scope or grant and claims no effective tenant permission.

Offline validation passed: TargetContext 5/5, full host suite 42/42, PowerShell parse 29 files with zero errors, Bicep compilation to valid JSON SHA-256 8820a75098c4e6c46eb97e574324f67dbd18b72ddbcf6f96d2c11c769a97cebc, canonical permission comparison tests 9/9, component/lock drift checks, backlog schema, generated Markdown and diff checks.
No Azure, Graph, deployment, report publication or live host operation was performed. Host-specific live execution, report access and cleanup remain under item 002 and are unchanged.

acceptance: Classify the report as still reproducible, already fixed, superseded or requiring live evidence; record the exact current revision.
